name: Monthly Attendance
query: WITH month_info AS ( SELECT CASE %(month)s WHEN 'January' THEN 1 WHEN 'February' THEN 2 WHEN 'March' THEN 3 WHEN 'April' THEN 4 WHEN 'May' THEN 5 WHEN 'June' THEN 6 WHEN 'July' THEN 7 WHEN 'August' THEN 8 WHEN 'September' THEN 9 WHEN 'October' THEN 10 WHEN 'November' THEN 11 WHEN 'December' THEN 12 ELSE 0 END AS month_num, %(year)s AS year ), month_days AS ( SELECT DAY(LAST_DAY(DATE(CONCAT(year, '-', month_num, '-01')))) AS days_in_month FROM month_info ) SELECT da.iqama_no AS "Iqama ID:Data:120", da.worker AS "Worker Name:Data:150", da.customer AS "Customer:Data:150", MIN(CASE WHEN da.status = 'Present' THEN da.date END) AS "First Present Date:Date:150", MAX(CASE WHEN da.status = 'Present' THEN da.date END) AS "Last Present Date:Date:150", SUM(CASE WHEN da.status = 'Present' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Total Present:Int:100", SUM(CASE WHEN da.status = 'Vacation' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Total Vacation:Int:100", SUM( CASE WHEN da.status = 'Absent' THEN 1 WHEN da.status = 'CO' THEN 1 WHEN da.status IS NULL OR da.status = '' THEN 1 WHEN da.status NOT IN ('Present', 'Vacation') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) + ((SELECT days_in_month FROM month_days) - COUNT(DISTINCT DAY(da.date))) AS "Total Absent:Int:100", MAX(CASE WHEN DAY(da.date) = 1 THEN CASE WHEN da.status = 'Present' THEN 'P' WHEN da.status = 'Vacation' THEN 'V' ELSE 'CO' END WHEN 1 <= (SELECT days_in_month FROM month_days) THEN 'CO' ELSE NULL END) AS "1:HTML:45", MAX(CASE WHEN DAY(da.date) = 2 THEN CASE WHEN da.status = 'Present' THEN 'P' WHEN da.status = 'Vacation' THEN 'V' ELSE 'CO' END WHEN 2 <= (SELECT days_in_month FROM month_days) THEN 'CO' ELSE NULL END) AS "2:HTML:45", MAX(CASE WHEN DAY(da.date) = 3 THEN CASE WHEN da.status = 'Present' THEN 'P' WHEN da.status =
